title: On Investing every penny in the new mill
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：invest　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 invest 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the planner ① invested every penny in the new mill in public, and every citizen in the district said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the planner ② invests every penny in the new mill in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ invest every penny in the new mill at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ invested every penny in the new mill before — a line in the report for March 1953 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Investing every penny in the new mill in public, the planner said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the plan at the far square, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ invest three years in the same work in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Invest three years in the same work at once and never mention it again.

By 1966 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the report, and a new citizen from the next district ⑧ invests three years in the same work in public every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the square, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ invested every penny in the new mill again when nobody else would.

⑩ To invest every penny in the new mill, my mother said in 1971, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the district remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the district forgets, somebody invests every penny in the new mill in silence again and somebody must invest every penny in the new mill in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 投资（一般过去式 invested every penny in the new mill：1959 年规划员头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 投资（一般现在 invests every penny in the new mill：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 投资（不定式 to invest every penny in the new mill：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 投资（过去完成时 had invested every penny in the new mill：1953 年三月的规划报告上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 投资（动名词 investing every penny in the new mill 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 投入（invest three years in the same work：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去投入在同一件事上投入三年）
G. v. 投入（invest three years in the same work：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 投资（后段两处：新来的市民照例 invests three years in the same work，而母亲又一次 invested every penny in the new mill）

answers.why: invest 意为“投资”，1959 年规划员当着众人面投资把每一个铜板都投进新磨坊，那是街区里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 invested。
invest 意为“投资”，自那以后规划员一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 invests。
invest 意为“投资”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯投资把每一个铜板都投进新磨坊”，此处为不定式 to invest every penny in the new mill。
invest 意为“投资”，规划报告里 三月 那行字说明早在 1966 年之前就有人投资过，故用过去完成时 had invested。
invest 意为“投资”，规划员说“投资把每一个铜板都投进新磨坊这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 investing every penny in the new mill 作主语。
invest 意为“投入”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去投入在同一件事上投入三年”，should ever 之后用原形 invest three years in the same work。
invest 意为“投入”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻投入在同一件事上投入三年（invest three years in the same work at once），以后再也不要提起。
invest 意为“投资”，新来的市民每个年份都照例投入在同一件事上投入三年，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 invests。
invest 意为“投资”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面投资把每一个铜板都投进新磨坊，用一般过去式 invested 叙述。
invest 意为“投资”，结尾那句是母亲 1971 年的话：要投资把每一个铜板都投进新磨坊，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和街区记住的那一件。

items: 1959 年，规划员当着众人面投资把每一个铜板都投进新磨坊；街区里每一个市民都说这是头一回。（invested every penny in the new mill）
多年以后，规划员仍一言不发地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（invests every penny in the new mill）

早在 1953 年就有人投资把每一个铜板都投进新磨坊，三月那天规划报告上的一行字就是证据。（had invested every penny in the new mill）
规划员说过，当着众人面投资把每一个铜板都投进新磨坊这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（investing every penny in the new mill 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻投入在同一件事上投入三年，以后再也不要提起。（invest three years in the same work，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 invest 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1959 the planner invested every penny in the new mill in public, and nobody in the district forgot it.
Even now the planner invests every penny in the new mill in silence whenever the district asks.
Investing every penny in the new mill in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever invest three years in the same work in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new citizen from the next district invests three years in the same work in public every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother invested every penny in the new mill again, and the district remembered that half.
